snippet.title: Thief's Shelter | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430930/Thiefs_Shelter/

Uncover what happened at Highburn Mansion — before it unravels your mind. Investigate, solve intricate puzzles, document elusive evidence, and question every shadow. Thief’s Shelter is a first-person psychological mystery where the deeper you dig, the more reality slips away.
